= Minio
:artifactid: camel-minio-starter

Store and retrieve objects in MinIO or another Amazon S3 compatible object storage.

== What's inside

* xref:{csb-camel-components}::minio-component.adoc[Minio component], URI syntax: `minio:bucketName`

Please refer to the above links for usage and configuration details.

== Maven coordinates

[source,xml]
----
<dependency>
    <groupId>org.apache.camel.springboot</groupId>
    <artifactId>camel-minio-starter</artifactId>
</dependency>
----
